raw_text: Thread: Apparent Chinese operational plan for Andaman Islands invasion circulating on Telegram. Details include specific unit designations (72nd Group Army Marines), ship types (Type 075 Hainan-class), and air assets (J-20). The level of specificity is unusual for open source. If authentic, this represents a major OPSEC failure by PLA or a deliberate information operation. 1/5
clean_text: OSINT analyst treating war game scenario as potential real Chinese operational plan. Notes unusual specificity of unit designations and assets. Considers it either OPSEC failure or information operation.
